text:
Maya (CS): quick heads-up — dropping the early-access invite batch for Project Helix at 3pm PT. We need final sign-off on the acceptance path + feedback form.
Ben (Product): thanks — can we gate the invite with the short pre-survey? Last time we got no qual feedback.
Maya (CS): yup, 3 q's only: primary use-case, latency sensitivity, team size. link -> https://forms.redwood.example/helix-quick
Liam (Solutions Eng): for acceptance path, suggest: 1) invite email 2) self-serve sandbox link 3) onboarding checklist in GH (repo: redwood/helix-onboard). Also enable feature-flag for telemetry opt-in.
Olivia (Ops): pinging @onboard-bot to queue the sandbox provisioning. want 50 concurrent seats, TTL 7 days.
onboard-bot: queued provisioning 50x g4dn-simulated seats for Project Helix. est ready in 12m. :package:
Ben (Product): can we add a forced quick survey after first 20 mins of usage? just 2 nudges max.
Maya (CS): yes. We'll capture qualitative w/ 3 open fields and an optional NPS at day 7.
Harvey (Helix): thanks — we have 5 engineers who'll try it today. please include an ops contact if something breaks.
Liam (Solutions Eng): @Harvey added you to the ops channel. Also attaching a tiny support snippet for the sandbox:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/session \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"model":"rw-medium", "max_tokens":512}'
```
Olivia (Ops): sandbox provision job done. URLs sent to invites list; infra metrics exported to /monitoring/helix/.
Maya (CS): great — I'll send the invite email copy below. Please review quickly:
"Hi Harvey — excited to share Helix early access. Click to claim your sandbox (expires in 7 days): https://redwood.example/claim/ABCD1234
We'd love 10 min quick pulse after you try it. —Maya"
Ben (Product): tweak: add 'expected latency' note and a short bullet on data retention.
Maya (CS): updated and sent. I'll follow up tomorrow with a short roll-up of first-run feedback. :eyes: 
Harvey (Helix): got it — claiming now, thx!
Maya (CS): thread note: if anyone sees >10% failure during first-day ramp, fallback to rw-small and notify eng-oncall. tagging @eng-oncall
Olivia (Ops): logging alert policy: if error-rate > 5% over 5m, page eng-oncall.
Ben (Product): thanks all — capture anything that looks like prompt regressions in the feedback sheet (column 'prompt_examples').
